constraints: Korean home meal / simple late-evening snack context
ordinary ceramic main plate and small ceramic dipping dish
kimchi pancake is cooked and pre-cut into bite-sized pieces
do not add unrelated side dishes, soup, garnish or extra utensils
dining_grammar: main plate is in the diner area
dipping dish is in a naturally reachable adjacent area
persistent world-space table topology changes only through explicit state_delta
visible tableware, gesture and utensil use must remain coherent with the declared meal context

preconditions: edge_piece_A is intact, uncoated and on pancake_plate
chopsticks hold no food and belong to the diner
pancake_plate and sauce_dish are in their initial persistent topology
action: Diner moves metal chopsticks toward edge_piece_A and stops just before or at initial contact without lifting the piece.
postconditions: chopsticks are positioned at edge_piece_A ready to grip
must_show: kimchi pancake as the dominant visual subject
metal chopsticks approaching the intended edge piece
must_not_show: unrelated side dishes or extra utensils
composition: Food-dominant close or medium-close view; crisp edge is the primary focal area; character face is optional and secondary.
